# Story 1.2: Session Management

Status: done

## Story

As a user, I want my session to persist so I stay logged in.

This story implements NFR56 (Performance) for session lookups.
Epic 1 is the parent epic.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Sessions persist for 24 hours
2. Session lookup is under 10ms
